# Kanaries Documentation

> > Technical documentation and guides for RATH, data visualization, AI-powered analytics, and data science workflows using Python, ChatGPT, and automated EDA tools.

Kanaries provides comprehensive documentation for RATH (an automated exploratory data analysis tool), along with tutorials on integrating AI language models like ChatGPT with data analysis workflows, machine learning projects, and modern data visualization techniques. The documentation covers both beginner-friendly guides and advanced technical implementations for data scientists and analysts.

## Key Topics

- RATH
- Automated EDA
- Data Visualization
- ChatGPT Integration
- Python Data Analysis
- Augmented Analytics
- Machine Learning
- Business Intelligence
- Jupyter Notebooks
- AI Language Models
- Data Cleansing
- Agent Communication
- SQL Analytics
- Data-Driven Decisions
- A2A Protocol

## AI-Powered Data Analysis

- [How to Use ChatGPT to Enhance Data Analysis Workflow](https://docs.kanaries.net/articles/chatgpt-data-analysis.en): Guide to using ChatGPT for data analysis workflow enhancement with RATH
- [Streamline Data Cleansing with ChatGPT](https://docs.kanaries.net/articles/chatgpt-data-cleansing): ChatGPT data cleansing tutorial for Excel and Python workflows
- [AI Agent Turns Jupyter Notebook Into a Data Science Co-Pilot](https://docs.kanaries.net/articles/jupyter-ai-runcell): Runcell AI agent for Jupyter Notebook autonomous data science automation
- [Augmented Analytics Explained: Benefits, Use Cases, and Challenges](https://docs.kanaries.net/articles/augmented-analytics): AI/ML-powered augmented analytics guide covering benefits and use cases
- [Automate Your Decision-Making with ChatGPT](https://docs.kanaries.net/articles/chatgpt-auto-decision-making): ChatGPT automated decision-making applications and industry use cases
